item.text: I’ll inspect the Eta template, README, and source validation logic to construct a valid input without running or building EXCLURAD. I’ll also check the near-threshold kinematics and record any required correction or warning in `outcome.json`.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc "pwd && rg --files eta pion && printf '%s\\n' '--- eta README ---' && sed -n '1,240p' eta/README.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- eta template ---' && sed -n '1,200p' eta/input.dat && printf '%s\\n' '--- eta source matches ---' && rg -n -i 'threshold|W\\b|Q2|q2|theta|phi|input|read\\(|read\\*|stop|error' eta/exclurad.F eta/fint.F eta/*.inc | head -240"
